title: SRP: geometry and rendering are coupled
purpose: Show Rectangle area/draw responsibilities link geometry to GUI.
alt: Rectangle의 area와 draw가 함께 있어 계산 기하와 그래픽 요구 사항이 결합된 구조
requiredChecks: Rectangle stores length/width, getLength/getWidth and both area()/draw().
Computational Geometry Application uses area(); Graphical Application uses draw().
Rectangle.draw() depends on GUI, creating unnecessary graphical dependency for geometry client.
Two distinct change sources are labelled without claiming every build tool recompiles everything.
